definitions.explanation: Of considerable size; prenominal adjective form.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: To speak in a loud voice.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{大|おお}きな⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。

examples.english: There's a big tree in the garden, so it's cool in summer.

notes:
{大|おお}きな is a pre-noun adjectival ({連体詞|れんたいし}): it only appears directly before a noun and has no other forms. It is not a na-adjective (there is no × {大|おお}きだ).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: the i-adjective. It can modify a noun (⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧) and also end a sentence (⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧), and it conjugates (⟦{大|おお}きかった→大きい：00335_ookii⟧). Before a noun either is usually fine; {大|おお}きな is especially common with abstract nouns ({大|おお}きな⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧, {大|おお}きな⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧, {大|おお}きな⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧).
- The same pairing exists in ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧ / ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧ and おかしな / おかしい.
